title: What the agent keeps for you

buildSteps.label: Your directions
buildSteps.description: Each thing you ask for is written down, quoted and dated, in the deck's tracker under docs/tracking. A later session reads it before it acts.

buildSteps.label: The storyboard
buildSteps.description: The plan under docs/plans lists every slide with its status, and changes together with the slides it describes.

buildSteps.label: A new session
buildSteps.description: Say "continue the deck tutorial-agents". It reads the plan and the tracker, and picks up where the last one stopped.
